description: The archived SA1 HEC-RAS 2D models cover selected Willamette River sections in Oregon and were developed at Tennessee Tech University. This resource is provided by Md Bhuyian; Alfred Kalyanapu. Coverage is regional as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The short metadata does not establish calibration conditions, simulation periods or model completeness. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
